manifest.name: dsh-paste-collapse
manifest.description: AI 输入框粘贴大段文本自动缩略为 [Paste #N +M lines] 小序号标签(编号不可改);👁 点击预览全文(点外关闭)、✎ 编辑名称、↺ 恢复纯原文;无删除按钮,删输入框标签文本即消失;发送时自动展开原文并加固定方括号纯标识块分隔(编号与输入框一致);slash 命令参数展开不加装饰;代理可用 myds_read_captured 工具按编号读取标签对应文本。
manifest.author: huenjie

bundle.text:
# dsh-paste-collapse bundle patch: mount the paste-collapse plugin.
#
# Applied when this bundle appears in a profile's dsh.profile.bundles list.
# The host half (package root) registers the /myds/captured route and the
# myds_read_captured tool; the browser half (dsh.client) is discovered
# automatically through the package's dsh.client declaration + exports["./client"].
#
# Note: the internal route (/myds/captured) and tool name (myds_read_captured)
# are kept for compatibility with the running host process and old captures.

- insert:
    - id: dsh-paste-collapse
      name: dsh-paste-collapse

declared.name: myds_read_captured
declared.description: 读取 dsh-paste-collapse 插件捕获的大段文本；可传 seq 读取指定编号，不传则读取最近一条。

readme.section: dsh-paste-collapse — DSH 静态插件:大段文本粘贴自动缩略
readme.text:
**中文** | [English](https://github.com/huenjie/dsh-paste-collapse/blob/main/README.en.md)

> 真正的**静态 Cordis 插件包**(双半:Host + 浏览器 Client)。
> 装入 `dsh web` profile 后,重启 `dsh web` 即自动加载,**无需动态重建、无需再次授权**。

readme.section: 1. 大段文本粘贴自动缩略
readme.text:
在 AI 输入框中粘贴文本时:

| 粘贴内容 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 真换行(掐掉首尾空白后仍多行) | **立即缩略**,不看字数 |
| 单行且 ≥ 100 字 | 缩略 |
| 其它(短单行、仅首尾伪换行) | 正常粘贴 |

> "伪换行"不算换行:首尾的空白/空行(如复制命令自带的行尾 `\r\n`)先掐掉再判断;
> 孤立的 `\r`(char 13)在网页里不产生可见换行,同样不算。真换行即是一个段落 → 缩略,
> 行数按掐掉首尾空白后的内容统计;存储与 ↺ 恢复仍保留原始字符。

readme.section: 1. 大段文本粘贴自动缩略
readme.text:
- 缩略后输入框只保留 `[Paste #N +M lines]` 标记(编号为小号连续整数,无冗长时间戳;
  命名后为 `[Paste #N | 名字 +M lines]`),插入点前后的已有内容保留。
- 完整文本由浏览器端 `localStorage` 持久保存(最多 32 条、每条最多 50,000 字)，Host 侧仍保留最近 8 条进程内存兜底，**不写入 Host 硬盘**。
- 输入框内部图片插入区(粘贴图片出现的位置)渲染标签芯片(只有按钮与编号),从左到右:
  - **👁 预览**:点击弹出完整内容卡片(可滚动);**点卡片外任意处**、点卡片右上角 ✕、
    或再点同块 👁 即关闭(不随悬停自动弹出/隐藏)
  - **✎ 编辑名称**:给这块起名(如 `版本A`),同步更新输入框标签为
    `[Paste #N | 版本A +M lines]`,发送时也显示在块标识里;留空提交即清除名字。
    **编号不可修改**(编号是唯一标识,由插件分配)
  - **↺ 恢复原文**:将对应标签**回写为纯原文**(不带任何块说明),直接回到输入框继续编辑
  - 没有删除按钮:**直接在输入框里删掉标签文本,芯片自然消失**
- 页面刷新后，输入框暂存的 `[Paste #N +M lines]` 标签会先从浏览器缓存恢复，
  不再因为客户端内存清空而变成无法引用的普通字符串；序号也会持久化，避免刷新后复用旧编号。
- 发送后,消息里的 `[Paste #N +M lines]` 标签会在"发出去"的那一刻**自动展开为完整原文**
  (本地缓存优先,Host 取回兜底),模型直接收到原文,无需再调用工具;输入框内仍保持标签样式。
- 展开时原文会被一对**纯标识首尾行**包裹(零语义解说,原文内容零改动),
  标识编号与输入框标签编号**完全一致**,只带:编号、可选自定义名、行数,例如:
  ```
  [Paste #12 | 版本A | 342 lines]
  <原文本>
  [End #12]

readme.section: 1. 大段文本粘贴自动缩略
readme.text:
这样连续粘贴的多块(例如要对比的两段代码)在模型侧边界清晰、编号与输入框一致,
  又不会被插件加任何解释性文字。
- 三处文本统一为同一套简洁短词:输入框 `[Paste #N +M lines]`(命名后带 `| 名字`)、
  芯片 `名称 #N`、发送块 `[Paste #N ...]` / `[End #N]`(**同一编号**,不会出现
  输入框是 `#12`、发给 AI 却是 `#1` 之类的不一致);↺ 回写为纯原文,不带块说明。
- 旧版插件的 `[Pasted text #N +M lines]` 标签仍会被识别、展开与编辑(兼容)。
- 带参数的 slash 命令(例如 `/agent-teams [长文本]`)会在命令提交前展开参数,
  但**不加块装饰**(纯替换),避免破坏命令解析。
- 仅当展开取不到原文（例如浏览器缓存被清理且 Host 进程也已重启）时,标签才会原样发出,
  此时代理可调用工具 `myds_read_captured` 按编号读回完整文本处理。

---

```
dsh-paste-collapse\
├── package.json        # 包声明:dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client(零依赖)
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 挂载声明:把 dsh-paste-collapse 一行插入 profile 插件树
├── lib\

---

安装:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-paste-collapse
```

移除:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-paste-collapse
```

安装/移除后重启 `dsh web` 生效。

---

readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add 本仓库目录路径

```
readme.section: dsh-paste-collapse — DSH static plugin: auto-collapse large pasted text
readme.text:
> A true **static Cordis plugin package** (dual-half: Host + browser Client).
> After being added to a `dsh web` profile, it loads automatically on the next `dsh web` restart — **no dynamic rebuild, no re-authorization**.
>
> Compatible with dsh **v0.1.2-rc.1**.

When you paste text into the AI input box:

| Pasted content | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Real line break (still multi-line after trimming) | **Collapsed immediately**, regardless of length |
| Single line, ≥ 100 chars | Collapsed |
| Everything else | Pasted as-is |

> "Pseudo" newlines don't count: leading/trailing whitespace and blank lines (e.g. the
> trailing `\r\n` that comes with copied commands) are trimmed before the check, and a lone
> `\r` (char 13) — invisible in the web UI — doesn't count either. A real line break means
> the text is a paragraph → collapse; line counts are computed from the trimmed content,
> while storage and ↺ restore keep the original characters.

- After collapsing, only a `[Paste #N +M lines]` marker remains in the input box (N is a small sequential integer, no verbose timestamps; after naming it becomes `[Paste #N | name +M lines]`), and the text on both sides of the insertion point is preserved.
- The full text is persisted in browser `localStorage` (up to 32 entries, 50,000 chars each); the Host side keeps the last 8 entries in process memory as a fallback and **never writes to disk on the Host**.
- In the input box's image-insert area (where pasted images appear), a label chip is rendered (buttons and number only), left to right:
  - **👁 Preview**: click to open a scrollable card with the full content; close it by **clicking anywhere outside the card**, the ✕ in the top-right corner, or clicking the same 👁 again (no auto popup/hide on hover)
  - **✎ Name it**: give this block a name (e.g. `Version A`), which updates the input label to `[Paste #N | Version A +M lines]` and also shows in the send block; submitting empty clears the name. **The number cannot be changed** (the number is the unique id assigned by the plugin)
  - **↺ Restore original**: writes the corresponding label **back as plain original text** (no block

So multiple consecutively pasted blocks (e.g. two code snippets to compare) stay clearly delimited on the model side, with numbers matching the input box, without any explanatory text added by the plugin.
- All three places share one consistent concise wording: input box `[Paste #N +M lines]` (with `| name` after naming), chip `name #N`, send block `[Paste #N ...]` / `[End #N]` (**same number** — no mismatch such as `#12` in the input box but `#1` sent to the AI); ↺ restores plain text without block decoration.
- Old-version `[Pasted text #N +M lines]` labels are still recognized, expanded and editable (backward compatible).
- Slash commands with parameters (e.g. `/agent-teams [long text]`) expand parameters before command submission, but **without block decoration** (pure replacement) so command parsing is not broken.
- Only when the original text cannot be retrieved (e.g. browser cache cleared and the Host process restarted) is the label sent as-is; the agent can then call the `myds_read_captured` tool to read the full text by number.

```
dsh-paste-collapse\
├── package.json        # package manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client (zero dependency)
├── cordis.patch.yml    # mount declaration: inserts dsh-paste-collapse into the profile plugin tree
├── lib\

---

Install:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-paste-collapse
```

Remove:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-paste-collapse
```

Restart `dsh web` after installing/removing.

---
